Endless Rails — is a fast-paced, action-packed survival roguelike about riding a train through monster-infested wastelands. Control combat drones, mount weapons on train cars, and destroy hordes of creatures trying to stop the train. Between stations, you'll need to constantly change the train's composition, upgrade its weapons, and find the right combinations of modules. Download Endless Rails Torrenting on PC is ideal for short, intense battles, where each subsequent stop becomes a new challenge.

Train in battle

At each station, you can spend your hard-earned cash on new train cars, weapons, drone slots, and additional upgrades. Train cars can be rearranged or identical components can be combined, increasing their power and opening up additional module slots. Drones automatically fire on enemies, allowing you to focus on building the most effective train. The further the train advances, the more intense enemy attacks become, making it more important to plan ahead.

Each run consists of short segments between stations, lasting about twenty to thirty seconds, but a lot happens during this time. After completing a run, earned resources can be spent on permanent upgrades, which open up new possibilities for subsequent runs. The main goal is to survive as long as possible and reach at least the twentieth station, although the tracks continue beyond that. The wasteland never ends, so survival becomes a never-ending test of your assembled train.
